subject: Post-demo: NovaRetail token profile & context needs — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaretail.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + quick ask on token mix/context needs

Hi Liam / Sana — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a couple of asks so we can produce a tailored cost estimate: 

Summary of what I took away from today:
- You want extractive product descriptions and a short social snippet from each product record at catalog scale (~2.4M SKUs).
- Typical generation per SKU: one 350–600 token prompt (metadata + examples) and an average completion of 80–150 tokens.
- A small subset (~3–5%) will require long-form creative descriptions (up to 1,500 tokens).
- You expect ~4M requests/month initially, ramp to ~12M over 12 months.
- Hard constraint: budget focus on unit $/1M tokens and predictable monthly spend.

Questions that will materially change pricing (please reply inline):
1) Avg prompt tokens across the 4M requests (you mentioned 350–600; can you give a tighter median or distribution?)
2) Ratio of short vs long-form (what % do you anticipate will be the 1,500-token completions vs standard 80–150?)
3) Any documents/assets fed into the model that push context needs (images/long product specs) such that you'd need 32k or 128k context for a fraction of calls?

Next steps I propose:
- You send the sample CSV slice (product rows + example prompt) — we'll run a short tokenization pass and return a sample token profile and cost sensitivity table. Attachment: RINF_Pricing_Summary.pdf (high-level unit costs and estimation methodology).
- We'll follow up with a 30-minute commercial sync once we have the token report to align on commitment tiers and required SLA.

Thanks — I looped Marissa (commercial lead) to help with contract/commitment questions.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: RINF_Pricing_Summary.pdf (9 pages), nova-token-sample-report.csv (placeholder)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaretail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@novaretail.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + quick ask on token mix/context needs

Hi Soojin — appreciate the recap. Quick answers inline: 

1) Prompt tokens: median ~420, 75th percentile ~540. The 350–600 range I gave earlier was rough but that's accurate for ~90% of calls.
2) Long-form ratio: about 4% will be long creative (~1,200–1,500 token completions). Another ~10% are extended descriptions ~300–500 tokens. Rest are short ~80–120 tokens.
3) 32k/128k needs: Rare. We have a content-enrichment flow where we might include a full supplier spec (~20–25k tokens) in ~0.3% of calls during data-normalization. No current plan to use 128k for production in year one.

Budget expectations: We are targeting ~$1.5k–$6k/month initially in hosted spend while we pilot (this is the platform subscription/inference cost), with a longer-term target to normalize cost to <$700 per 1M tokens once we hit reserved volumes. However, we need clarity on unit costs today for planning.

I'll drop a 200-row sample CSV to the Drive link you sent.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Engineering | NovaRetail
liam.oconnor@novaretail.com

Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + quick ask on token mix/context needs

Thanks Liam — this is super helpful. A few follow-ups and what we'll deliver after we process the CSV: 

What we'll run (deliverable):
- Tokenization pass on your 200-row sample to produce: median/p90 prompt tokens, median/p90 completion tokens, and an 8k/32k/128k exposure estimate (i.e., what % of calls would exceed each context boundary).
- Cost sensitivity table with three SKU assumptions: hosted pay-as-you-go, 6/12-mo reserved tiers, and a blended committed tier showing $/1M tokens at different monthly volumes.
- A short note on caching opportunities and how prefix/KV caching could reduce token counts for repeated catalog writes.

Immediate asks from you (two bullets):
- Confirm whether the supplier spec rows include HTML or long free-text fields (those increase tokenization).
- If you have an internal target for acceptable latency (p50/p95) for the long 1,200–1,500 token calls, share it — it affects model selection and cost.

I'll get the token report back by EOD Thursday (Jan 14). Marissa — once we have the numbers, can you prepare two commitment scenarios (conservative and aggressive) with target $/1M token points for our commercial discussion?

Best,
Soojin

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaretail.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@novaretail.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + quick ask on token mix/context needs

Hi all — jumping in with a short commercial note and one hypothesis: given the mix Liam outlined (median prompt ~420, avg completion ~120, 4% long ~1.3k tokens), the economics below are our high-level starting point for negotiation. Detailed numbers will follow after Soojin's token pass.

High-level unit economics (illustrative):
- Pay-as-you-go: $1,800 per 1M tokens (hosted standard model baseline)
- Committed 12-mo reserved (monthly commit > 50M tokens): $560 per 1M tokens (blended higher-efficiency serving / batch + quantized model)
- Hybrid (dedicated pool for long-form at 32k context + hosted for short flows): blended $/1M tokens approx $720–$900 depending on traffic split and cache hit rate.

Observed sensitivity: each 10% increase in long-form share moves blended $/1M by ~+$45–$70 depending on how many of those long calls hit 32k vs can be truncated/rolled into cached context. The small 0.3% 32k exposure Liam mentioned is low-impact unless those calls are high-frequency during normalization.

Immediate asks to finalize pricing:
- Final token profile from sample (Soojin)
- Confirm whether NovaRetail will consider a 12-mo reserve if blended price is below $600/1M tokens (helps us allocate dedicated capacity efficiently)

Marissa — can you prepare a slide with the two commitment scenarios and include estimated monthly spend at 4M, 8M, and 12M requests (using the current token mix) so we can show NovaRetail both per-token and normalized monthly billing?

Liam / Sana — thanks again for the quick turnaround on the sample CSV — we'll get you the token report and the sensitivity matrix by EOD today.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Attachment note: I'll share a short pricing slide within the hubspot deal after we ingest the sample.
